description:
Deletes the schedule. Its stored files stay as plain stored backups, unless files is true, which removes them too and fails with busy (409) while a backup or restore runs.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch) and the token's Allow delete switch

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: true removes the schedule's stored files as well; anything else keeps them.

200.description: true when the schedule was deleted
